full_prompt_en: A square abstract painting fills the entire field with overlapping bursts of saturated color and visibly different marks. Broad powder-blue and violet areas establish a loose background, while hot pink ribbons cross the center and lower edge. Golden yellow and tangerine patches appear in irregular islands, including one crisp orange circle in the upper-right region. Black and indigo marks interrupt these bright areas with scraped bars, loops and pooled dark spots. Thin drips descend from the upper edge and from several larger painted masses, making gravity and the sequence of application visible. Some passages are opaque and heavy; others look rubbed back, sprayed lightly or partially covered by a later layer. Small spatters in cyan, red and yellow travel across the surface without forming a repeated pattern. There is no central emblem or recognizable subject: attention shifts across edges, collisions, open intervals and accidental-looking joins. Despite the energy, the composition is balanced by a broad pale blue top, darker marks at the sides and a sweeping pink band near the bottom. The surface has the varied tooth of an urban wall or heavily worked canvas, with traces of previous layers visible beneath new color. The finished work feels improvised but considered, vivid in palette and convincingly physical in the behavior of paint.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅正方形抽象绘画将整个画幅填满，饱和色彩相互覆盖，各种笔痕差异清晰可见。粉蓝与紫色大面建立松散底层，亮粉色带状痕迹横穿中央和下缘。金黄与橘色以不规则岛状色块出现，右上方有一枚边缘较清楚的橙色圆形。黑色与靛蓝以刮擦横条、回环和积聚暗斑打断亮色区域。细滴痕从上边缘及几处大色团向下流，显出重力和上色先后。有些区域厚重不透光，另一些像被擦去、轻喷，或被后续颜料遮盖了一部分。青色、红色与黄色小飞溅穿过表面，却不形成重复图案。画面没有中心徽记或可识别题材，注意力在边缘、冲撞、空隙与看似偶然的接点之间移动。尽管能量很强，宽阔浅蓝上部、两侧深色标记与底部横扫粉色带仍保持构图平衡。表面有城市墙面或厚涂画布般多变的颗粒，旧层痕迹从新颜色下显露。最终作品看似即兴，实则经过斟酌，配色鲜活，颜料行为具有可信的物理感。
style_prompt_en: The style is large-scale abstract street painting with layered spray, opaque brush swipes, scraped bars, loose loops, scattered specks and gravity-driven drips. Saturated pink, violet, sky blue, cyan, yellow and orange collide with black and indigo interruption marks. Surface tooth, partial erasure and visible earlier layers give the color physical depth. A square edge-to-edge composition remains energetic without a fixed center, its rhythm carried by broad fields, narrow streaks, isolated round accents and uneven gaps. The effect is improvised, tactile and boldly chromatic.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格属于大幅抽象街头绘画，包含层叠喷绘、不透明笔刷横扫、刮擦横条、松散回环、散点飞溅与受重力牵引的滴痕。饱和粉、紫、天蓝、青、黄和橙与黑色、靛蓝的阻断笔迹相撞。表面颗粒、局部擦除和可见旧层赋予色彩物理深度。正方形满幅构图充满能量，却无固定中心；宽阔色域、细窄条痕、孤立圆点与不均匀空隙共同形成节奏。效果即兴、可触摸且色彩大胆。
theme_en: An exuberant layered field of spray, brush, drips and color
theme_zh: 喷绘、笔刷、滴痕与色块交叠的奔放画面
name: HENSE
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
